name: Ink and Anguish
source:
You play (name customizable) as an ordinary librarian who discovers an ancient, fragmented book in the forbidden archives. Upon reading its puzzling pages, you’re torn from your reality and thrust into the lives of women across time—each trapped in their own tragic tale. To escape, you must "complete" their stories by altering pivotal choices. With every leap through time, the stakes—and the horrors—grow darker. Will you unravel the truth behind the book, or lose yourself in its cursed pages?  

[From [url=https://bigdeal.itch.io/ink-and-anguish-complete-version]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演（名字可定制）一名普通图书管理员，在禁书档案中发现一本古老的、支离破碎的书籍。读完这本令人费解的书页后，你会脱离现实，进入不同时间段女性的生活——每个人都陷入自己的悲惨故事中。为了逃脱，你必须通过改变关键选择来“完成”他们的故事。随着时间的每一次飞跃，赌注和恐惧都会变得更加黑暗。你会揭开这本书背后的真相，还是会迷失在被诅咒的书页中？

[来自[url=https://bigdeal.itch.io/ink-and-anguish-complete-version]Itch.io[/url]]
